Have enough detail. Summarizing.

## Login
Entirely client-side, no backend auth call. `AuthService.login(username)` (`frontend/src/app/services/auth.service.ts`) checks `localStorage` key `ai_dnd_user_<username.toLowerCase()>` via `loadProfileByName`. If found, loads that `UserProfile`; otherwise creates a fresh `{ username, campaigns: [] }` and persists it. `LoginComponent.login()` (`login.component.ts`) calls this then routes to `/characters` (new) or stays to show campaign slots. `AuthGuard` (`auth.guard.ts`) gates routes using `auth.isLoggedIn()` (profile !== null).

## Campaigns storage
Stored only in browser `localStorage`, under two keys per user:
- `ai_dnd_user` — "current" profile
- `ai_dnd_user_<username>` — per-user profile

Each `UserProfile.campaigns` is a `CampaignSlot[]` (`game.models.ts`) holding `slotId`, `characterName/Class/Race`, `level`, `sessionId`, `characterId`, `lastPlayed`, `location`. The real game state (character stats, session) lives server-side: character rows in D1 (`c.env.DB`, via `worker/src/services/character.ts`), session state in KV (`c.env.SESSION_KV`, via `worker/src/services/session.ts`).

## Deleting a campaign slot
`LoginComponent.deleteCampaign()` calls `AuthService.removeCampaign(slotId)`, which just filters the slot out of `profile.campaigns` and re-persists the profile to `localStorage`. **No API call is made** — there's no DELETE route in `worker/src/routes/session.ts` or `character.ts`. The server-side character row in D1 and the KV session are never removed; they become orphaned/unreachable data, still present in the database but with no client-side reference to them.
